tbesh_html:
1) to act treacherously, deceitfully, deal treacherously
1a) (Qal) to act or deal treacherously, faithlessly, deceitfully, offend

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage
strongs_1890.kjv_def: deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), [idiom] very.
